description: The University of New South Wales publishes processed samples of Transport for NSW vehicle positions and performance metrics for Sydney and its surroundings. The deposit covers March 2018 ferry, light-rail, city-rail and regional-rail positions, plus April 2018–April 2019 examples for bus route 370 and rail location and delay. Selected delay data are aggregated to one-minute intervals. Mendeley Data provides public access under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost, with attribution to the researchers and Transport for NSW. The landing-page description explains the packages but does not establish their internal file encoding. A key limitation is that the deposit contains subsets of a study database exceeding 800 million records, not that entire archive. Cleaning and aggregation may also change the apparent variability of delays. These historical samples can help calibrate transit movement or reliability simulations and test performance visualisations. They complement live operator feeds with reproducible historical observations. Their earlier rejection as single-study supporting data conflicts with the current rule to include documented resources valuable for reuse.
